definitions.explanation: Having the beauty, imagery, or evocative quality of poetry — describing language, scenery, or a moment as poetic rather than describing an actual poem.

examples.japanese: {詩的|してき}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧。
⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{詩的|してき}だった。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{詩的|してき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: His writing has a reputation for being poetic and beautiful.

notes:
{詩的|してき} is ⟦{詩|し}→詩：02139_shi⟧ (poem) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like, -ic), describing something as having a poetic quality rather than being a poem itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詩的|してき}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: poetic expression
- {詩的|してき}な⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧: poetic scenery
- {詩的|してき}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: poetic words

Same-sounding but unrelated words: ⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧ (pointing out) and ⟦{私的|してき}→私的：06350_shiteki⟧ (private, personal) — all share the reading してき but differ in kanji and meaning.
